resources.string: Psiphon picks the protocol itself, as before. The CDN edges below are still offered for any fronted protocol it chooses.
The ordinary Psiphon protocols (SSH, OSSH, TLS, QUIC, meek), CDN fronted ones included. Server issued tactics are turned off.
Every byte goes through a big CDN edge (Akamai or Fastly) with an innocent looking SNI. For networks where nothing but the major CDNs gets through. Slower than the others.
Psiphon runs through Aether in this mode, so the QUIC variants are skipped: a SOCKS hop cannot carry UDP.

Leave both blank to use the built in Akamai and Fastly edges. Custom edges (IPv4 or CIDR, separated by commas or new lines) are probed before connecting. The SNI is the name the network sees in the TLS handshake; blank means the edge IP itself.
